Inside the depot

The depot photographs were taken over three mornings in November. The light comes from the north windows, so the east end of the shed is in shadow until ten.

The pit under the first track is deep enough to stand in, which is why most of the maintenance happens there rather than on the raised tracks.

By the fourth morning the shed was empty again and the trams were back on the line.
